design.md:
# Generated baseline (the studio made this; improve it)

Template: **tycoon**. The kit runs the whole core loop; game.json and the world spec configure it. Write code only for what the template does not do (as systems with specs), never a second copy of the loop or the HUD.

Plots: 4 Candy plots round the plaza; each has a line of buttons that unlock droppers, a conveyor, an upgrader and decor, prices rising with the income. Players start with 25 to buy the first button.

Tutorial quests: Buy your first dropper → Collect your cash → Buy 4 more upgrades → Build the whole tycoon.

World: Generated 1649 objects (about 2886 parts).
  - Art style: stylized.
  - 4 plots of 12 items each; prices 25, 80, 175, 475, 825, 1800, 3300, 4700, 8000, 11000, 16000, 25000.
  Models by role: conifer 900001
  
Brief must-haves to check against: A plot per player with droppers, a conveyor and a collector; At least 12 buttons in a sensible order; A rebirth with a multiplier; A leaderboard
